newsitem.title: USA: Salomon Brothers names three new research analysts.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Brothers names three new research analysts.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc said it named three new equity research analysts: Marie Conway, Lawrence Fisher and Paul Knight.
Conway will cover health services companies; Knight will cover industrial services and technology. Both were previously at National Westminster Bank Plc affiliate NatWest Securities.
Lawrence Fisher becomes chemical company analyst. He was previously with Sanford Bernstein covering the global chemical industry.
Salomon Brothers is a unit of Salomon Inc.
